text:
Ethan Ross: Heads up from KinetiCare AP 11 they say renewal invoice shows platform surcharge line that we don't recognize. @MayaKapoor @LuisFernandez can you check?

Maya Kapoor: Which invoice?

Ethan Ross: INV-2026-0528 in the portal. Procurement attached screenshot.

Support Billing Bot: Invoice INV-2026-0528 generated by billing-pipeline v3.3.2 11 link https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-0528

Luis Fernandez: Pasted lines below from the PDF: ```Invoice INV-2026-0528
Customer: KinetiCare Solutions
Period: 2026-12-01 - 2026-12-31
 - Platform Fee (Private License): $24,000
 - Platform Surcharge (edge-network): $2,400
 - Reserved Capacity: $48,000
 - Support (Enterprise): $15,000
Total: $89,400```

Maya Kapoor: Hmm. Contract CNTR-1145 shows no edge-network surcharge. They opted for VPC-only private deployment. No network add-ons. That surcharge looks like an experimental SKU that should only bill for customers in the beta. KinetiCare was never enrolled.

Ethan Ross: Procurement wants corrected invoice asap for PO. Can we confirm amount to credit?

Luis Fernandez: Remove the $2,400 line => credit $2,400. Also double-check support tier effective date: Sales notes show Enterprise effective 2026-12-15 (upgrade mid-month). Pipeline applied full month Enterprise; should prorate. Enterprise full month $15,000 vs Standard $12,000. Prorate delta for 16 days Enterprise (12/15-12/31) vs 14 days Standard (12/01-12/14) yields additional $1,142 owed by customer? Let me calc: prorate Enterprise portion: 16/31*15,000=7,742; Standard portion: 15,000? wait Standard is 12,000 full, prorate 15/31*12,000=5,806. Net for month should be 7,742+5,806=13,548. Pipeline charged 15,000, so overcharged $1,452. Combined with removing surcharge $2,400 net credit = $3,852.

Maya Kapoor: I can confirm contract effective dates. Good catch. So we owe customer $3,852.

Support Billing Bot: Creating ticket BILL-9974: "unexpected surcharge + support prorate misapplied on INV-2026-0528".

Contracts: Confirmed amendment AMD-1145 shows Enterprise effective 2026-12-15. No surcharge.

Ethan Ross: Draft neutral customer message: "We identified an inconsistency on invoice INV-2026-0528 and have issued a credit memo for $3,852. A corrected invoice will be reissued within 48 hours. Apologies for the disruption; please let us know if you need additional docs for PO processing." Thoughts?

Maya Kapoor: Good. Add procurement contact (Ethan) and Sales (Luis) on the email.

Finance Ops: Preparing CM. Need final confirmation of net credit amount.

Luis Fernandez: Confirmed net credit $3,852. Reissued invoice should be INV-2026-0528R with lines: Platform Fee $24,000, Reserved Capacity $48,000, Support (prorated split Std/Ent) $13,548 => corrected total $85,548.

Finance Ops: Created CM-2026-074 for $3,852 and reissued INV-2026-0528R. Uploaded to portal and emailed procurement with neutral wording and contract excerpt.

Support Billing Bot: BILL-9974 assigned to eng-billing. Unit tests added to prevent expired experiment SKUs and to fix support prorate calculation.

Ethan Ross: Procurement confirmed they received corrected invoice and will proceed with PO. Thanks team.

Finance Ops: Journal entries posted, credit applied. Marking thread resolved.

Support Billing Bot: INV-2026-0528 status: corrected (INV-2026-0528R). CM-2026-074 applied. BILL-9974 in progress until deploy."
